'''Savrip Clan''' was one of the many many [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clans]] that prospective young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] were placed in when they first began to learn the ways of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Named after the [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Savrip]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], the clan was stationed at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] .
